basis: OnePlus's own stock camera, made by OnePlus (OnePlus Technology (Shenzhen) Co., Ltd.). Each 'what' starts with the phones it applies to: [both], [6T] or [9 Pro]. Sources: OnePlus official user manuals (the 9 Pro manual describes the OxygenOS 11 camera; the 6T manual was written for its launch software, OxygenOS 9), OnePlus official spec pages, the OxygenOS 11 release notes for the 6/6T, and, as a last resort, reviews (GSMArena, Photography Blog, Guiding Tech), each marked '(review)' in 'what'. OxygenOS 11 for the 6T's camera is documented only as 'Updated the camera UI and optimized some of the function paths' (XDA changelog). So the 6T entries describe the feature set from the 6T manual, spec page and launch review, and its OxygenOS 11 layout and labels may match the 9 Pro's: not verified. The local dump set_oneplus.xml/png is the first camera screen of a phone with 0.6x/1x/3.3x lenses (the 9 Pro), but its labels ('Dazzle AI Color', the 'ALTRO' more-modes tab, Italian UI) do not appear in any OxygenOS 11 source found. It looks like a later OxygenOS camera build, and its entries are tagged '[9 Pro, local dump, later build]'. The dump also shows no settings list, only the viewfinder. Not reachable: no official OnePlus page lists the OxygenOS 11 camera Settings menu item by item, so that list comes from a review (Photography Blog). The OnePlus community forum and Play listing were not used: com.oneplus.camera is preinstalled, not a public Play listing. Settings group names (General/Photo/Video/Pro mode/Portrait) are assigned by this inventory: no source gives the OxygenOS 11 menu's own group headings.

features.name: Photo
features.what: [both] Default point-and-shoot still mode

features.name: Video
features.match_note: Resolutions/fps depend on what Camera2 exposes to third-party apps

features.name: Portrait
features.what: [both] Depth-effect (background blur) photos on the rear and front cameras; 9 Pro on-screen guidance to move closer or farther
features.match_note: Vendor True Portrait only: Camera1-only Qualcomm vendor setting; not shown under Camera2

features.name: Studio Lighting
features.what: [6T] Portrait lighting effect that tones shadows and highlights on the subject's face; the 9 Pro manual mentions a 'professional portrait lighting effect' in Portrait
features.match_note: No portrait lighting effect

features.name: Nightscape
features.what: [both] Low-light mode that blends short exposures for night scenes (6T launch name 'Night Mode')
features.match_note: No night mode; frames can be shot as DNG and stacked afterwards by hand

features.name: Nightscape tripod mode
features.what: [9 Pro] Tripod icon in Nightscape: 8-30 s exposure with an automatic self-timer (review)
features.match_note: Manual long exposure plus self-timer, without frame stacking

features.name: Starburst
features.what: [9 Pro] Nightscape variant that renders point lights as starbursts (review)
features.match_note: No starburst rendering

features.name: Pro
features.what: [both] Manual photo mode, Hasselblad-styled UI on the 9 Pro (labelled 'Pro'); main lens only on the 9 Pro (review)
features.match_note: Manual strip is always on the camera screen; all lenses

features.name: ISO

features.name: White balance

features.name: Shutter speed
